description: Cumulative bounded-screening coverage ledger. It counts pairs that have a submitted or accepted screening package, not pairs with a certified relation. screenedPairs holds the 21 accepted R2/R3 pairs, submittedPairs holds the 46 R4 pairs (accepted-R4), and r5SubmittedPairs holds the 69 R5 pairs (submitted-R5-pending-review before independent review; a uniform flip to accepted-R5 is the lead-only acceptance step). cumulative.screenedPairCount counts all three lists; acceptedPairCount and submittedPairCount are derived from the row states.

cumulative.note: 136/136 pairs have a submitted-or-accepted screening package; before independent R5 review the accepted count is 67/136 (R2 10 + R3 11 + R4 46) and the 69 R5 rows are submitted-R5-pending-review. Remaining is 0 because every R1 pair now has a named query or a statement-level outOfScope record. Screened is not certified: queryOutcomes counts named queries (152), not pairs. This ledger does not self-accept; the lead flips the R5 rows after the six independent reviews.

knownSeams: Round-frozen pins: the accepted R3 screening package pins this ledger by hash (bounded_audit/r3/screening.json snapshot.coverageLedgerSha256 and coverageReference.sha256) and its accepted validator pins the R3 ledger state (21/115). Advancing this ledger through R4 and R5 necessarily changes that hash and those counts. The accepted R3 content gate is bounded_audit/r4/validate_r3_content.py, which excludes exactly the seven enumerated current-ledger freshness checks; the original bounded_audit/validate_r3.py still reports exactly those seven stale-ledger checks and is not claimed to be green against this ledger.

R4 CI package pin: bounded_audit/r4/conical-01/validate.py pins cumulative.screenedPairCount to {21, 67}. After R5 the count is 136, so bounded_audit/r5/validate_r4_ci_content.py is derived from the accepted CI validator and excludes exactly the one stale check coverage.cumulative; every other CI content/evidence check and the accepted-R2/R3-set checks remain. The original CI validator is unchanged and is expected to fail only coverage.cumulative against this later ledger.

R4 round-frozen gate: bounded_audit/r4/validate_coverage.py is an R4 integration gate and is run only against the frozen snapshot bounded_audit/r4/coverage-accepted.json. It is not expected to be green against this advanced 136/136 ledger, and this ledger does not claim that it is.

Anti-cycle design: this ledger records hashes of the R2 package and of the R4/R5 packages (screening, search log, fragment, probe, validator), none of which pins this ledger. It deliberately records no hash of bounded_audit/r3/screening.json (that accepted package pins this ledger) and no hash of itself. Do not add a self-hash or an R3-screening hash here: either would close a hash cycle. The five R5 packages never read or pin this mutable ledger and their fragments remain immutable submission snapshots.

Snapshot drift: the R5 package REPORTs record this ledger at its pre-integration R4 hash d1e44bf7bbb5e81c7b85f610d6ffc1d4d3fed0fcde5cd1ab3202fb23ca6c32fa. That value is historical; no package validator reads or pins the ledger.
nonClaims: Screened is not the same as certified: a pair may have an unresolved, notEstablished or outOfScope query.
The 136/136 count is a bounded-audit coverage count, not an exhaustive or final classification.
Before independent R5 review, the 69 R5 pairs were submitted-R5-pending-review; after the independent reviews passed, the lead uniformly flipped them to accepted-R5. This ledger did not self-accept.
Before independent R5 review, accepted coverage is 67/136; 136/136 is submitted coverage, not accepted coverage.
The cumulative count includes submitted packages; it is not a claim that the submitted packages have passed review.

The 69 R5 rows are accepted only if the lead flips them uniformly to accepted-R5 after the six independent reviews pass; the R5 coverage validator computes accepted/submitted totals from the row states and needs no edit for that flip.
The cumulative ledger is not a completeness claim about conceivable relations outside the frozen bounded query protocol.

frozenSnapshots.role: Frozen accepted-R4 ledger snapshot, preserved unmodified. It is an input of the historical R4 integration gate (r4/validate_coverage.py --coverage bounded_audit/r4/coverage-accepted.json) and does not pin this ledger.
